description: Source code for an AI service module that interacts with the Anthropic AI SDK to generate summaries, quizzes, feedback, and other educational content within an LMS platform. It includes functions for normalizing quiz data, generating prompts, and handling role-based chat interactions.

classes.name: AIService
classes.description: Class encapsulating methods for generating educational content, summaries, quizzes, feedback, and role-based chat interactions with the Anthropic AI SDK.

methods.name: normalizeQuiz
methods.description: Normalizes and validates a quiz schema with exactly 5 questions, each with questionText, options, and correctAnswerIndex.

methods.name: normalizeLearnerQuiz
methods.description: Normalizes a learner quiz with exactly 10 questions, each with questionText, options, and correctAnswerIndex.

methods.name: generateSummary
methods.description: Creates a concise 3-paragraph summary of lesson content.

methods.name: generateQuiz
methods.description: Generates a 5-question multiple choice quiz based on lesson content, ensuring schema validity.

methods.name: generateLearnerQuizWithCount
methods.description: Creates a variable number (1-20) of MCQs for learner self-assessment based on a topic.

methods.name: generateLearnerQuiz
methods.description: Creates a 10-question MCQ quiz based on topic and difficulty level.

methods.name: generateAssignmentDescription
methods.description: Generates a detailed assignment problem statement from a prompt.

methods.name: generateQuizFeedback
methods.description: Provides feedback on learner quiz performance, highlighting strengths and areas for improvement.

methods.name: generateAssignmentFeedback
methods.description: Provides instructor feedback on an intern’s assignment submission.

methods.name: gradeLearnerAssignment
methods.description: Grades a learner’s assignment against a problem statement, returning pass/fail and feedback.

methods.name: chat
methods.description: Role-based AI chat interface for instructors, managers, admins, or learners, with context-aware prompts.

methods.name: generateYoutubeSearchKeyword
methods.description: Creates a concise YouTube search string for supplemental learning based on course and lesson context.

methods.name: analyzeSkillGap
methods.description: Analyzes user skills and goals to recommend learning paths and identify skill gaps.

methods.name: generateLearningPath
methods.description: Generates a personalized learning path based on goals, skills, and quiz performance.
